{{Quote|Files acquired during Operation: Freefall reference a "Doctor E. Lokin" working as Science and Medical Advisor to Kaas City military police during this period, but no visual is provided.|SIS dossier on Lokin|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Operation: Freefall''' was a clandestine operation conducted by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence agency, during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" /> Sometime between [[3681 BBY]] to [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> the SIS recovered files on the Empire during the operation. Analysis of those files included mentions of a "[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin|E. Lokin]]" who worked before the war as [[Science and Medical Advisor]] to the [[Kaas City military police|military police]] of [[Kaas City]], the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Sometime afterwards, the [[Capture of the Warhammer|capture]] of the Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|dreadnaught]] ''[[Warhammer]]'' saw the first confirmed sighting of Lokin.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation: Freefall was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Doctor Lokin in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
